If you're a fan of Mach33 research and you're not plugging the MCP/Connector into your agents (my preferred is grok bot) then you are falling behind. 

just a few moments ago, 20 days after a very quiet release, total research interactions from MCP eclipsed total research visits on our site over the same time.

The median user on the site has read 2 analysis over the last 20 days and the median user on the MCP has made 36 analysis calls. 18x more depth of engagement. 

the really nutty thing is that this trend is actually meaningfully accelerating over the same amount of time, across free users and paid users. 

this does not include internal users which would dramatically accelerate this trend. 

do yourself a favor and connect the Mach33 MCP to grok/claude/chat gpt whatever you use.  
https://research.33fg.com/mcp-guide

You're agent will get much smarter on any space/spacex related question.
